techs.name: Sleight of Arm
techs.notes: Reach 6 m. Steals 1 BP to the pool; if there is nothing to steal, steals a consumable. A giant coin that says 'BP!'.

techs.name: Guile Feint
techs.notes: SINGLE 1.5, reach 3.0 (AoE 1.0 -> 0.5 misdirect); 1 hit + feint. Steals 1 BP; the target's next action indicator (who it will hit) is shown to the party. +50% after Cyrus_Cut_Down.

techs.name: Guile Elastic
techs.notes: SINGLE 1.5 + feint clone; 1 hit + steal. Steals 2 BP at Lv2+; the clone taunts for 2 turns. Used 12 times on the same boss without defeating it: an Amber Rift (+15 Prismatic, once per cycle).

techs.name: Swap Face
techs.notes: GUILTY for 2 turns: each of the victim's attacks has a 50% chance to hit one of its own allies. It wears Glenn's droopy eyes.

techs.name: Prop Hammer
techs.notes: Strongman Dummy (E57) drop. 300% squash windup. +1 shave if the target fails the squash test (inflated or rubber targets). +50% vs the Ash-Knight.

techs.name: Balloon Escape
techs.notes: Inflates: squash-dodges to 4 px, immune to [FIRE] for 2 s, and the next BP theft against the party this battle fails.

techs.name: Honest Laugh
techs.notes: Debt move: Glenn to 1 HP, Fragile 2 turns. Below 25% HP: self-shatter shows the hollow with the origami frog (+5 Light the first time). +2 BP. The ally's next hit counts as an honest GUILE hit; aimed at Crono's ASTRAL, it breaks the Ash-Knight's theft cycle.

techs.name: Prop Cannon
techs.notes: The blackened carnival's last gag (Charred Laurel, blackened).

techs.name: The Last Joke
techs.notes: Vaelos only. Costs all party BP (at least 3). Forces Vaelos to laugh. His chest atom-cluster cracks: his next 3 received hits ignore shields and DEF. His Lavos-Truth aura negates lies, except Glenn's.
